goal.summary: I explicitly want both image classification and text generation, in separate stages.

fields.topic: Image classification and character-level text generation
fields.outcome: Compare both tasks through small staged experiments

purpose.summary: Compare both learning tasks through small staged experiments.

response.reply: Both goals are intentional; plan them as small stages within the confirmed budget.
